crossRefs.note: On its hem you shall make pomegranates of blue, and of purple, and of scarlet, all around its hem; with bells of gold…
a golden bell and a pomegranate, a golden bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe.
Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.
Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates, with precious fruits, henna with spikenard plants,

translations.web: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;
translations.bsb: They also made bells of pure gold and attached them around the hem between the pomegranates,
translations.kjv: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
translations.asv: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the skirts of the robe round about, between the pomegranates;
